***** PART B (Authenticated DHKE) *****
Generating RSA key pairs for Alice, Bob, and Eve along with the shared DH group
DH public parameters:
P = 103327964873096419674724912443338006129348299095532170537939791803345825591919 + (-17717598310720589492490089538408736952394064694519637009226151211350982396672)I
Both coordinates of P are 256 bit safe primes p = 2q + 1

Finding a generator for the first coordinate p = 103327964873096419674724912443338006129348299095532170537939791803345825591919:
 try g = 13
 g^((p-1)/2) mod p = 103327964873096419674724912443338006129348299095532170537939791803345825591918
 g^((p-1)/q) mod p = 169
 Neither result is 1, so 13 generates the units mod p.
By the same test the second coordinate accepts g = 5

G = 13 + (-8)I
ord(G) = lcm(a-1, a+b-1) = 4422972474465039034095598883984675994928612225880063851765478780293200936917407348661689946031819597387836873766023202927781948363555923974468771196810914
